# Current official native disclosure regression captures

These compressed public-source bytes reproduce complete multi-page card pricing
and amount-first account-fee loss. `manifest.json` and `checking-source.json`
pin their official URLs and SHA256 of decompressed original bytes. Retrieved and verified on 2026-10-10. Card bytes are from the latest retained
Run; account bytes are from direct current capture. Publication uses fresh captures; no private storage keys, user data or candidate artifacts are included.
The source bytes remain unchanged; normalization never updates expected hashes.

`test_extended_card_terms.py` checks original APR alternatives, dated index,
complete promotional purchase-interest conditions, independent unconditional
fees, waiver-note retention and cross-bank/type conflict/origin boundaries.
